gloss: to drain off moisture; to pat dry

definitions.gloss: to drain off moisture; to pat dry; to wring out water
definitions.explanation: To remove excess water or moisture from food, laundry, or other items. A common cooking and household term.

examples.japanese: ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水気|みずけ}を{切|き}る。
examples.english: To drain the moisture from tofu.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}ったら→洗う：00827_arau⟧、⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{水気|みずけ}→水気：07952_mizuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: After washing the vegetables, please drain them thoroughly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水気|みずけ}→水気：07952_mizuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}らない→切る：02693_kiru⟧まま⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧はねて⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: If you fry without draining the moisture, the oil will splatter and it's dangerous.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily a cooking term. ⟦{水気|みずけ}→水気：07952_mizuke⟧ (moisture, water content) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut/remove). Essential in Japanese cooking where excess moisture affects texture and oil temperature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{水気|みずけ}→水気：07952_mizuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to drain well)
- ⟦{水気|みずけ}→水気：07952_mizuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to drain thoroughly)
- ⟦キッチンペーパー→キッチンペーパー：25045_kicchinpeepaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{水気|みずけ}→水気：07952_mizuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to remove moisture with a paper towel)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to drain water — similar meaning, slightly more general
- ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧: to evaporate moisture — using heat rather than draining
